⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Compassionate Member Contact

Trauma-informed PPF contact for members entering PPF protection. No cold calling within 14 days of scheme transfer notification. Single point of contact. Pension-loss-sensitive communications.

2. Full Compensation Protection

No PPF member left worse off than their accrued scheme benefits where possible. 90% floor maintained. Cap indexed to inflation. Dependant benefits preserved.

3. Digital-First Scheme Assessment

Automated scheme eligibility determination. Real-time funding level monitoring. Predictive insolvency detection. 48-hour benefit statement generation.

4. Fraud Zero-Tolerance

Pension liberation detected within 72 hours. Contribution evasion flagged automatically. Cross-scheme fraud intelligence sharing. HMRC/Pension Regulator integration.

5. Buy-Out Acceleration

Target: 80% of PPF eligible schemes achieving buy-out within 10 years. Enhanced transfer value programmes. Insurance market engagement.

6. Retirement Option Optimisation

AI-driven retirement option comparison. Flexible access guidance. Annuity vs drawdown analysis. Tax-efficient withdrawal modelling. Pension Wise integration.

7. Actuarial Transparency

Open-data scheme funding levels. Public dashboard of PPF 7800 Index. Stress test results published quarterly. Recovery plan progress tracking.

8. Parliamentary Accountability

Annual PPF impact report to Parliament. Levy methodology transparency. Member outcome benchmarking. International comparison. Social value quantification.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No PPF member contacted within 14 days of scheme transfer for routine business — compassion over compliance
  • ❌ No PPF compensation below 90% of accrued benefits (below cap) — minimum dignity standard
  • ❌ No scheme insolvency decision made without member notification within 24 hours
  • ❌ No pension liberation scheme left undetected beyond 72 hours — zero tolerance for pension fraud
  • ❌ No retirement option presented without personalised comparison modelling — informed choice mandatory
  • ❌ No PPF levy calculation published without full methodology transparency — audit-grade accountability
